sections.heading: Interface layout
sections.body: Sidebar and Chat controls change how navigation and chat are arranged on supported screen sizes. These preferences affect presentation only and do not change character progression.

sections.heading: Identity and access
sections.body: Account settings show the current character and available sign-in methods. Guest accounts can bind email or Gmail to protect access and unlock account-restricted features. Character-name changes and credential actions show their requirements before saving.

sections.heading: Session and support
sections.body: Sign Out ends the current session on this device. Game links provide beta, support, and patch-note destinations. Review the displayed build version when reporting a problem.
